artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan applying the A1 / A1-Gamma / A3 component rows to ADEQUACY.md and TRUST_PIPELINE.md, resolving two cross-document contradictions, and migrating WitnessFamily/Compression citations from line anchors to the name + manifest convention.

memory_candidates.content: Cross-repository documentation citations written as file.lean:NNN drift silently: no gate on either side reads them, so every anchor can go stale while both repositories stay green. The structural fix is to cite by fully-qualified declaration name plus file (file for orientation only) and resolve names through a generated, gate-checked citation manifest in the producing repository. When planning such a migration, build the conversion inventory with two complementary greps, not one: a path-prefixed grep misses citations written with a bare module basename, and bare basenames collide across sibling subtrees (an Enumerate.lean citation can belong to an out-of-scope subtree), so every bare-name hit needs its containing subtree confirmed before conversion. Mixed rows that cite two subtrees at once convert per-anchor, never per-row.
